name: adr-agent
description: Local agent protection, conversation search, and credentials without raw values in model requests.

interface.shortDescription: One plugin for agent security and observability.
interface.longDescription: Search local conversations, use saved credentials in local commands, and apply your file-protection rules. Credentials reach local programs; filtered output reaches the model. No per-key or per-project setup.
defaultPrompt: Find the earlier conversation about this task.
